card.fires_on: Marked words that sit in the middle of a clinical term, such as the end of an abbreviation (EMs, NSCLC, 5-FU), a hyphenated metabolite name (2-hydroxy), or a linking word such as 'with' after 'treatment' or 'associated'.

modes.label: Abbreviation or chemical name pieces
modes.description: A letter or short piece inside an abbreviation, hyphenated name or metabolite name.

modes.label: Linking words in drug-study text
modes.description: The word 'with' or a noun like 'outcome' right after a treatment or event term.
